hub.title: Games
chicken.title: Chicken Pursuit
chicken.instructions: You and another chicken race to the food. Arrow keys stay aimed at north, marked by the arrow, and do not turn with the yard. Higher levels grow the yard, turn it more often, and speed the other chicken.
chicken.controls.desktop: Arrow keys or WASD follow north. A tap on the yard moves toward that spot. Space or Enter starts the next race.
chicken.controls.touch: The pad follows north. A tap on the yard moves toward that spot. Tap Again for the next race.
void.title: Space Warp
void.instructions: Shoot the ships and rocks. Each hit costs hull.
void.controls.desktop: WASD or the arrow keys fly. Click to aim and hold to shoot, or hold Space. Space starts the next run.
void.controls.touch: Drag to fly. Hold still to shoot, or add a second finger while dragging. Tap Again for the next run.
